testCases.label: Test case where the target is not found (Expected: False)
testCases.description: Verifies that arrayContains returns 'false' when the value '5' is missing from the array {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}.

testCases.label: Test case where the target is found at the end (Expected: True)
testCases.description: Verifies that arrayContains returns 'true' when the value '4' is present in the array {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}.

testCases.label: Test case with different array, target is absent (Expected: False)
testCases.description: Verifies that arrayContains returns 'false' when the value '5' is missing from the array {8, 7, 3, 6}.

testCases.label: Test case with duplicates, target is found (Expected: True)
testCases.description: Verifies that arrayContains returns 'true' when the value '7' is present (even with duplicates) in the array {9, 7, 7, 3}.
